**Organ Cave South** is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update.

A location in The Forest, inhabited by Cult of the Mothman. It is part of the cave system that includes Organ Cave West and Organ Cave North.

Organ Cave South appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update.
